claims.claim: The canonical synthetic lifecycle records a distinct InitialProjectRequest document reference, Lead-approved Brief, accepted Planning Package, planning acceptance, explicit decisions, Design Direction Set, single Design selection, TaskGraph, TaskContracts, and an uninvoked START_IMPLEMENTATION gate without customer artifacts.

Project creation, Lead clarification, and non-persistent contact-form behavior each have explicit planning responsibilities, requirement edges, TaskGraph ownership, acceptance criteria, and validation traceability.
The sole current executor declares every detailed capability required by the canonical TaskGraph and each current TaskContract is bound to the task capability, tool, skill, file, and artifact scopes.

The accepted planning package, architecture, environment, DatabaseDecision, DataContract, and START_IMPLEMENTATION guard consistently express NONE with no persistent entity, Supabase variable, schema, RLS, migration, or database task; the contact intent is NOT_PERSISTED.
The selected Design checksum is current in TaskGraph sourceDocumentChecksums.design and the exactly-three-direction invariant is deterministically exercised.
Deterministic currentness, checksum, source/document reference, planning, capability, DataContract, TaskContract, and Contract Auditor checks all pass; stale references are rejected.

priorCurrentContractFindings.summary: The approved interactive requirements have references in tasks but no semantic implementation or validation trace.
The sole current executor does not declare the capability identifiers required by the TaskGraph tasks.
The package declares databaseMode NONE while planning and execution still require persisted approved_requests data, RLS, Supabase variables, and database validation.
The fixture names InitialProjectRequest separately from Brief, but supplies no artifact or reference that makes the distinction auditable or enforces the stated START_IMPLEMENTATION gate.

ca-001.rootCause: The R3 fixture had requirement references but no semantically dedicated planning/task responsibility for the approved interactive requirements.
ca-001.repairApplied: Canonical planning now has explicit home, contact, and form responsibilities; canonical TaskGraph tasks have dedicated project-creation, Lead-clarification, and contact-form objectives, ownership, acceptance, and validation traceability.
ca-001.remainingState: Resolved deterministically; fresh semantic call is the final authorization check.

ca-002.rootCause: The prior fixture left TaskGraph sourceDocumentChecksums.design empty.
ca-002.repairApplied: TaskGraph sourceDocumentChecksums.design is bound to the current selected Design checksum.
ca-002.remainingState: Preserved resolved; deterministic currentness check passes and ca-002 is not in the R4 scope.

ca-003.rootCause: The R3 executor catalog covered coarse execution labels but not every detailed capability identifier required by TaskGraph tasks.
ca-003.repairApplied: The current executor catalog declares all registered detailed TaskGraph capabilities, and canonical current TaskContracts bind those capabilities to every task.
ca-003.remainingState: Resolved deterministically; fresh semantic call is the final authorization check.

ca-004.rootCause: The R3 fixture mixed a NONE database decision with generated persistence, Supabase, schema, RLS, environment, and database-task obligations.
ca-004.repairApplied: Canonical planning is normalized to zero entities, empty Supabase/schema/RLS/environment obligations, no database tasks, and an explicit NONE DatabaseDecision; the only contact DataContract is NOT_PERSISTED.
ca-004.remainingState: Resolved deterministically; no customer persistence was invented.

ca-005.rootCause: The R3 fixture mentioned InitialProjectRequest as a lifecycle label without a distinct auditable artifact identity and checksum-bound reference.
ca-005.repairApplied: InitialProjectRequest is created through createInitialProjectRequest, persisted in the fixture with requestId/reference/checksum, traced to Lead-derived Brief, and checked by the START_IMPLEMENTATION gate before implementation is eligible.
ca-005.remainingState: Resolved deterministically; implementation start remains uninvoked.

reviewPolicy.scope: Contract Auditor only: ca-001, ca-003, ca-004, ca-005; ca-002 preserved resolved
